pin_convention: sha256 of the canonical Git blob, i.e. `git show <commit>:<path> | sha256sum`. NOT the worktree file's sha256: the two differ for every file under code/ and lean4/ in a CRLF checkout and agree only for artifacts/**, which .gitattributes marks -text. The convention is declared once, here, and verify_pins.py recomputes it the same way on every platform.
snapshot_note: the freeze commit of this tree, an ancestor of HEAD. Pins are checked at this snapshot AND at HEAD; a difference is reported rather than tolerated.

what_each_pin_is_for.artifacts/bounds.json: the sealed declared bounds, whose shape this tree's own bounds block imitates
what_each_pin_is_for.artifacts/challenges.json: the sealed Challenge-3 answer, transcribed into code/calibration.py and asserted field by field. The external anchor CI already gates and this tree cannot tune
what_each_pin_is_for.artifacts/lean_axioms.txt: the gated axiom inventory. Every sealed theorem this tree cites as CHECKED is confirmed present there
what_each_pin_is_for.code/derivation/candidates.py: the four sealed item kinds, the canonical item order, mu1 and mu2, and the sealed Bounds. Re-implemented in code/items.py and code/enumerate_space.py
what_each_pin_is_for.code/derivation/engine.py: the two sealed genesis histories and their targets, and the sealed _quotient's grouping on the child after Impose. Re-implemented in code/regime.py and code/price.py
what_each_pin_is_for.code/derivation/iso.py: the sealed isomorphism relation and the equivariant pair-orbit policy. Re-implemented in code/quotient.py as the brute-force minimum, with equality asserted against the sealed refined key
what_each_pin_is_for.code/derivation/model.py: the Regime, the six sealed events, step and replay. Re-implemented in code/regime.py
what_each_pin_is_for.code/derivation/observe.py: the observation relation. Line 56 is the fact this tree turns on: derivability is an or of a coverage bit and an admission bit. Re-implemented in code/grammar.py
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/CapacityBound.lean: CITED as the estate's prior shape for a bounded observer failing on a growing carrier; this tree derives its own threshold natively and inherits nothing
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/Compression.lean: CITED for chain_bounded and strict_steps_lt. The transport is NOT inherited: this tree proves its own chain bound over its own reader partitions
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/ContactKernel.lean: CITED for obs_eq_of_fields, which fixes the disagreement space of two observers
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/DiffInterface.lean: CITED for DiffObs carrying its equivalence laws as fields, which is why lawfulness here is a decided precondition on admission rather than an assumption
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/Minimality.lean: CITED for cost1_insufficient_general, the shape of a complete-within-the-bound impossibility this tree imitates
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/NoOutside.lean: CITED for admitEvaluator_base_inert and stepC_conservative, the precedent that admitting observation apparatus does not touch kernel state
what_each_pin_is_for.lean4/Derivation/Represented.lean: CITED for wit_all_lengths and wit_no_infinite, the estate's statement that witnesses at every length assemble into nothing

evidence_labels.CHECKED: confirmed present in the gated artifacts/lean_axioms.txt
evidence_labels.CITED: read directly from a pinned source; for a research tree, a manual receipt read by no gate. No research tree's verify_lean.py is run by anything, this tree's included.
